programme.title: Disaster DIY

programme.title: Disaster DIY

programme.title: Disaster DIY
programme.desc: Bryan teaches Joe how to reno his kitchen from scratch.

programme.title: Disaster DIY

programme.title: Disaster DIY
programme.desc: Doug and Kim have some space issues. The laundry room is in such bad need of repair that she won’t even let her three sons in there to learn how to do their own laundry. But Doug has done so much wrong...

programme.title: Disaster DIY
programme.desc: Paul has started to reno the basement to add some much needed space to the crowded house. His wife Lisa is concerned that he really doesn’t know how to proceed, and that he might be making some dangerous choices!

programme.title: Disaster DIY
programme.desc: Single dad Dan has two young daughters and is living in a messy and potentially dangerous incomplete reno. During the demolition, he had grand plans, but really doesn’t know how to put them into action.

programme.title: Disaster DIY
programme.desc: Donna’s husband Chris refused to fix their outdated and badly damaged kitchen, so while he was visiting home in Greece, she took matters into her own hands. She demolished the kitchen, but didn’t know what to do next.

programme.title: Disaster DIY
programme.desc: Aaron and Evadne bought a fixer-upper as their first home, and both are eager to get their hands dirty. He’s tried to reno the laundry and she’s tried to fix the basement window. They’ve both made a mess.

programme.title: Disaster DIY
programme.desc: Bill fancies himself a handyman, but his wife Joanne disagrees. She’s tried to cover his reno mistakes with decorative touches, but now that the raccoons have moved into their ramshackle shed.

programme.desc: After going more than half a century without renovations, Julia and John are hoping their worn-out family cabin - built by John’s grandfather - can start generating money for them.

programme.title: Scott's Vacation House Rules CA

programme.title: Blaze and the Monster Machines

programme.title: Blaze and the Monster Machines
programme.desc: Blaze stops into Gabby’s Garage for a quick repair – just as she gets an alert! Three far-flung trucks need her mechanical know-how! So, Blaze and AJ volunteer to help her take her garage on the go!

programme.title: Blaze and the Monster Machines
programme.desc: All of Axle City is enjoying the Balloon Fair – until Crusher and Pickle get stuck on a runaway hot-air balloon! Now it’s up to Blaze and AJ to rescue their high-flying friends… before they crash into the Slime Volcano!

programme.title: Blaze and the Monster Machines

programme.title: Blaze and the Monster Machines
programme.desc: When a windstorm blows away the supplies for Stripes’ Animal Party, Blaze transforms into the one Monster Machine strong enough to haul it all back – a Big Rig! There’s nothing he can’t pull with that Big Rig Force!

programme.title: Blaze and the Monster Machines
programme.desc: Blaze and AJ make friends with a space alien named Gormy! But when Gormy’s jetpack loses power, they set out to help him find six special space batteries so he can fly home to his alien family!

programme.title: Blaze and the Monster Machines
programme.desc: Blaze and AJ are spending the day with some very special trucks: Blaze’s family! His Mom, Dad, and little sister Sparkle join Blaze in a race against Crusher to prove they’re the world’s fastest family!

programme.title: Blaze and the Monster Machines

programme.title: Holmes: Buy It Right
programme.desc: Newlyweds Robyn and Anthony are interested in a move-in ready income property or a low-priced home that needs some work, and they're attracted to 100-year-old Craftsman-style houses, but they need Mike's help to make a smart purchase.

programme.title: Mike's Ultimate Garage

programme.title: Mike's Ultimate Garage
programme.desc: The garage is well under way but winter is fast approaching.

programme.title: Holmes 10th Anniversary Special: Behind The Overalls
programme.desc: Get a heartfelt look back at 10 years in the life of Canada's construction guru.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: Demons and Dragons: The Turtles begin training with the mysterious Ninja Tribunal, experimenting with new powers and weapons despite Splinter's reservations, not to mention his portentous dreams of their demise!

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles

programme.title: House of Bryan
programme.desc: As the build moves closer to the end, war wages between Bryan and Sarah as decisions on interior finishes need to be made.

programme.title: House of Bryan
programme.desc: Bryan and Sarah’s disagreement on the final finishes for the fireplace add fuel to the fire as choosing interiors becomes more tense.

programme.title: House of Bryan
programme.desc: Bryan gets to work on the tile and is realizing an eighth of an inch difference is a bigger thorn in his side than it’s worth! Sarah and Bryan choose a mural for their Great Room that could end up being a great disaster.

programme.title: House of Bryan
programme.desc: Bryan focuses on getting the outside of the cottage completed.

programme.title: House of Bryan
programme.desc: Bryan is worried when transporting custom materials on site almost breaks the bank.

programme.title: House of Bryan

programme.title: House of Bryan
programme.desc: Snow and heavy rain put a wrench in progress as Bryan’s big sprint to complete the deck - the last major project of the build - comes to a screeching halt. Sarah has a huge surprise for Bryan that changes the game.

programme.title: House of Bryan
programme.desc: Bryan and Sarah do a final walk-through and recount the most memorable moments of the build.

programme.title: Leave It To Bryan

programme.title: Scott's Own Vacation House
programme.desc: Scott is putting his own vacation rules to the test when he and Sabrina buy their own vacation property. One with several cabins which they hope to turn into income properties to invest in the future for the family.

programme.title: Income Property
programme.desc: Connie and Sebastian are hands on first-time homeowners. This 100-year-old Victorian semi-detached used to be a rooming house. The bubbly couple got rid of most of the evidence from the previous apartments, but...

programme.title: Income Property
programme.desc: When Jay and Kathryn moved into their new home they never thought they would outgrow it so fast! With two kids in the family space is at a premium. Kathryn and Jay need an income suite to increase the value.

programme.title: Income Property
programme.desc: Kirk and Stephanie bought their dream house 3 years ago, and they intend to keep the basement as an income suite to give them long-term security.

programme.title: Income Property
programme.desc: Peter purchased an expensive, fully renovated Victorian in a hip downtown neighbourhood last year. Adding a potential rental suite in the basement was his plan and the key to bringing down his substantial mortgage.

programme.title: Income Property
programme.desc: Martin and Isidora have found their dream home, but the basement needs a lot of work. Closing date has been pushed up by 3 months, and they have already promised their tenant she can move into their basement apartment.

programme.title: Income Property
programme.desc: Tai and Beatrice have dug themselves into a hole, both literally as well as financially. They went way over budget when they purchased their dream home, and began digging a hole in their basement to upgrade plumbing.

programme.title: Income Property
programme.desc: Elliot bought his first home and has big dreams for it. Unfortunately bigger isn’t always better. His elaborate plans are taking way too long and costing way too much. Scott is going to show him how to spruce it up.

programme.title: Income Property
programme.desc: Heather is a teacher who bought a newly renovated bungalow with a 'ready to rent' two-bedroom basement apartment but a home inspection revealed some minor fixes for which Heather set aside over $20,000.

programme.title: Antiques Roadshow
programme.desc: The roadshow comes from Ebrington Square in Londonderry and has a table made from the gifts given by a Chinese emperor and an amethyst pendant.

programme.title: Antiques Roadshow
programme.desc: The roadshow looks back on some of the most memorable stories like Uppark House in West Sussex and a Georgian manor, asking what happens next?

programme.title: Antiques Roadshow
programme.desc: Fiona Bruce and the team visit Pitzhanger Manor and Gallery in Ealing, West London, where treasures include a royal paintbox, a collection of Italian jewelry and a medal awarded to a carrier pigeon.

programme.title: Antiques Roadshow
